        …

faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful for any person subject to the provisions of this article to advertise
               or hold out or state to the public or any person, directly or indirectly, that the
               admissions tax or any part thereof imposed by this article, will be assumed or absorbed
               by such person, or that it will not be added to the price charged for admission, or,
               if added, that it or any part thereof will be refunded.
(Code 1981, § 31-137; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002)
